title_zh: 决定拒绝附带独家背书条件的赞助

scenario.label_zh: 决定不接受带独家背书条件的赞助
scenario.goal_zh: 核对赞助要求与活动独立性冲突，并决定拒绝当前条件

context_zh: 社区修理工作坊组织者讨论一家工具商提供的赞助草案。
author: author-phase10-c

sentences.speaker: Marcel
sentences.text: The sponsor wants us to endorse its tools during every repair session.

sentences.speaker: Faye
sentences.text: I thought the offer only asked for a logo on the programme.

sentences.speaker: Marcel
sentences.text: The latest draft requires an exclusive endorsement. We could not recommend any competing tool.

sentences.speaker: Faye
sentences.text: That would stop our instructors from giving independent answers. We should not accept it.

sentences.speaker: Marcel
sentences.text: Could we ask for a simple logo acknowledgment instead?

sentences.speaker: Faye
sentences.text: We could, but they have already refused that twice. I would rather decline this offer than keep negotiating.

sentences.speaker: Marcel
sentences.text: I agree. I will write back declining the current terms and make clear that we are not promising any endorsement.
